statements.attributed: designed and prepared WNbMoTa and WNbMoTaV RHEAs with yield strengths of 1058 MPa and 1246 MPa at room temperature
statements.quote: For example, Senkov et al. took the lead in designing and preparing WNbMoTa and WNbMoTaV RHEAs with yield strengths of 1058 MPa and 1246 MPa at room temperature (RT), respectively.

statements.attributed: developed a ductile TaNbHfZrTi RHEA with plastic strain ε ≥ 50% and yield strength of 929 MPa
statements.quote: Since the limited RT plasticity of these two RHEAs restricts their engineering applications, Senkov and his coworkers then developed a ductile TaNbHfZrTi RHEA with plastic strain ε ≥ 50% and yield strength of 929 MPa .

statements.attributed: designed and synthesized HfMoTaTiZr and HfMoNbTaTiZr RHEAs with yield strengths of 1600 MPa and 1512 MPa
statements.quote: In order to further improve the strength, Juan et al. designed and synthesized HfMoTaTiZr and HfMoNbTaTiZr RHEAs based on the TaNbHfZrTi RHEA, where a yield strength of 1600 MPa and 1512 MPa were achieved, respectively.

statements.attributed: reported that high activation elements take a long time to reach the hands-on standard after the decommissioning of relevant equipment, for example, ~104 and ~3 × 105 years for Mo and Nb

statements.attributed: synthesized a novel low-activation WTaHfTiZr RHEA, and the compression test result showed that the yield strength and fracture strain at RT are 1900 MPa and 8.1%

statements.attributed: reported a low activation RHEA consisting of all refractory elements (TiVZrTaW), only the microstructure and the hardness at different temperatures were presented
